crime: Every evening, a girl played pool alone in the recreation room and talked the whole time to {WITCH_NAME}, who sat faded out of sight on the wall bench. {WITCH_NAME} never stayed for a goodbye. Before one could come, she slipped out unseen, and the door swung open by itself. Every time, the girl called goodbye after it.
That night, the girl reached the bench first. She found {WITCH_NAME}'s hand and said goodbye slowly.
For a week, {WITCH_NAME}'s mother had held her hand every morning and said goodbye just that slowly. On the eighth morning, her mother was gone.
{WITCH_NAME} opened the door and did not leave. She let it swing shut.
"See you tomorrow!" the girl called after it.
As the girl bent over the table to shoot, {WITCH_NAME} slammed her head into the pool table until she lay still.
Out in the second-floor hall, prisoners had heard that "See you tomorrow." From then until the lockup call, they watched the door. No one came through it.

In the trial court, the prisoners ruled that she had slipped alone and struck her head on the pool table. But the prisoner who found her had sunk down onto the wall bench, and it was still warm. Then they understood: {WITCH_NAME} had sat there, faded, until they came in.
fields.epitaph: The one goodbye she stayed for only meant see you tomorrow.
execution: The execution stand was an iron doorway in the trial court. She was chained upright inside it, one wrist to each jamb. The iron door swung shut on its own, into her head and chest. It fell back and swung shut again, and again, and again. At last it came to rest ajar against her slumped body, and could not close.

magic.name: Into Thin Air
magic.text: She can fade from sight, clothes and all, while staying right where she is.
